meanings.note: Used with の to modify the following noun (次のお二人様, 次の駅).

examples.trans: I get off at the next station.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: 次から次へとアイデアが浮かんできてよ、もう止まんねえんだよ。
examples.trans: New ideas keep popping into my head one after another—I can't stop.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

examples.text: 想像以上だよ。これからは過激な本番シリーズをどんどん作っていく。
examples.trans: Sales are beyond imagination. From here on we will crank out bold real-action series.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: 想像以上だよ。これからは過激な本番シリーズをどんどん作っていく。
examples.trans: Sales are beyond imagination. From here on we will crank out bold real-action series.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Loanword from English 'series'.

examples.text: 新しいシリーズが始まります。

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: Humble noun form of 待たせる, used in apologies like お待たせしました.

examples.text: 大変お待たせいたしました。
examples.trans: Thank you very much for waiting.

examples.text: お待たせしてすみません。

meanings.note: Humble (kenjougo) equivalent of する, used in polite business and apologetic expressions.

examples.text: すぐにご連絡いたします。
examples.trans: I will contact you right away.

meanings.note: Compound ichidan verb formed from する + すぎる.

examples.text: 最近働きすぎています。
examples.trans: I've been working too much lately.

examples.text: 心配しすぎないでください。

meanings.note: Short for かもしれない; expresses possibility or uncertainty.
Ichidan verb; most commonly appears in the set expression かもしれない ('might be').

examples.text: 遅れるかもしれません。
本当かもしれませんよ。
examples.trans: It might be true, you know.

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: polite auxiliary in ありがとうございます
meanings.note: Survives in modern speech chiefly in ございます (present) and ございました (past) after ありがとう and おめでとう.

examples.text: ありがとうございます。
ありがとうございました。
examples.trans: Thank you very much (for what just concluded).

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

meanings.note: i-adjective describing embarrassment or self-consciousness.

examples.text: ちょっと恥ずかしいです。
恥ずかしい思いをした。

meanings.note: Colloquial quotative/emphatic particle expressing surprise or dismissal.

examples.text: そんなことなんて知らない。
examples.trans: I don't know anything like that.

examples.text: 嘘だなんて信じられない。
examples.trans: I can't believe it's a lie.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。
むしろあるがままに生きることが人間らしさではないでしょうか？
examples.trans: Rather, isn't living just as we are what makes us truly human?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

meanings.en: as it is; one's natural, unaltered state
meanings.note: Often used with に (あるがままに) to mean 'just as one is'.

examples.text: あるがままを受け入れる。

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Ichidan verb.
Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Formed from 人間らしい ('human-like') + -さ.

examples.text: 人間らしさを大切にする。
そこに人間らしさがある。

meanings.note: More formal counterpart of じゃあ used in business and polite conversation.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Polite presumptive form of copula だ; with rising intonation, seeks agreement.

examples.text: 明日は晴れるでしょう。
examples.trans: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Refers to humans in general or human nature.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.

meanings.en: that (near the listener or just mentioned)
meanings.note: Must always precede a noun (その椅子 'that chair').

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Used with が before it (ストーリーが必要だ 'a story is needed') or な before a noun.
Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.
Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
